records.metric: Sustainable ROE: 17.0%-17.5% | NIM: 4.25%-4.30% | Credit Cost: <50 bps
records.summary: Management targets sustainable consolidated ROE of 17.0%-17.5% and NIM near 4.25%-4.30% with benign credit costs.
records.verbatim_quote: Management remains committed to sustaining a consolidated Return on Equity (ROE) of 17.0% to 17.5% over the medium term through risk-calibrated core operating profit growth, maintaining Net Interest Margin near 4.25%-4.30% and keeping credit provisions below 50 basis points of average advances.

records.metric: Uncapitalized Tech & Branch Capex Contracts: Rs 2,840 Crore
records.summary: Capital commitments for branch expansion, cloud data centers, and AI digital banking infrastructure stand at Rs 2,840 Crore.
records.verbatim_quote: Estimated amount of capital contracts remaining to be executed on account of tangible branch network expansion, cloud data centers, and AI digital banking infrastructure and not provided for stands at Rs 2,840 Crore as at March 31, 2026.

records.source_document: ICICI Bank Integrated Annual Report FY2025-26 (Schedules 12, 18 & Ind AS Notes)
records.metric: Disputed Tax/Legal Claims: Rs 8,420 Crore (2.85% of Net Worth)
records.summary: 94% of headline contingent liabilities are hedged forex/swap notionals; actual disputed tax/legal claims are only Rs 8,420 Cr (2.85% of Net Worth).
records.verbatim_quote: Total contingent liabilities stood at Rs 18,45,200 Crore as at March 31, 2026, of which notional principal of back-to-back hedged foreign exchange forward contracts and interest rate derivatives accounted for Rs 17,34,480 Crore (94.0%), while disputed income tax and legal claims not acknowledged as debt were Rs 8,420 Crore (representing 2.85% of Shareholders' Net Worth).

records.metric: Arm's-Length Subsidiary Bancassurance RPTs: Rs 1,620 Crore (1.75% of NII)
records.summary: Related party transactions with insurance and AMC subsidiaries are strictly arm's-length (1.75% of NII) with zero director loan exposure.
records.verbatim_quote: During FY26, all transactions with consolidated subsidiaries and associates including ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, ICICI Lombard General Insurance, and ICICI Prudential AMC were conducted on an arm's-length basis in the ordinary course of bancassurance and investment banking business, aggregating Rs 1,620 Crore (1.75% of Net Interest Income), with zero promoter or director loans outstanding.

records.source_document: Reliance Industries Integrated Annual Report FY2025-26 (Consolidated Financial Notes 34, 35 & 38)
records.summary: Guidance locks Net Debt/EBITDA below 1.0x as 5G capex moderates and Jio/Retail EBITDA doubles over four years.
records.verbatim_quote: Consolidated capital allocation prioritizes doubling EBITDA contribution from Consumer and Digital platforms (Jio and Reliance Retail) over the next four years while maintaining Consolidated Net Debt-to-EBITDA strictly below 1.0x as 5G spectrum and network capex intensity moderates.

records.metric: Committed Unexecuted Capex: Rs 42,600 Crore (Jamnagar New Energy)

records.metric: Total Contingent Liabilities: Rs 64,850 Crore (7.80% of Net Worth)
records.summary: Contingent liabilities are modest at 7.80% of Net Worth, mainly telecom spectrum bank guarantees and EPC bonds.

records.metric: Inter-Segment Eliminated RPTs: Rs 42,630 Crore (4.20% of Revenue)

records.summary: Management locks 24.5%-25.0% near-term EBIT margin floor and 80%-100% FCF payout to shareholders.
